To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of reflexive methods in policy sociology is a good idea.

1. the use of reflexive methods is a good strategy for the researcher in a policy sociology project, 2. the use of such methods may be particularly effective in the case of research commissioned by public authorities, 3. the use of heuristic investigation is a good strategy in the case of policy sociology projects, 4. the use of the reflexive methodology of heuristic investigation is an effective research strategy in the case when policy sociology research is commissioned by the client.

(1) heuristic investigation is a research strategy that is particularly suitable for the kind of commissioned research that is the focus of this paper; (2) the reflexive approach can help the researcher in this type of research; (3) heuristic investigation is an approach which can help the researcher not only to overcome the limitations of the client’s presence but also make the apparent disadvantages of the situation work for her.
